hero.headline1: Turn your WhatsApp into a sales-ready catalog in minutes.
hero.headline2: Built for small businesses in Mexico.
hero.sub: Create a branded catalog, share one link, and convert chats into orders without technical setup.
hero.free_tier: 7 weeks free, no credit card required.

items.title: Online in minutes
items.body: No code, no designers. Set it up from your phone and it's ready the same day.

items.title: Orders via WhatsApp
items.body: Customers pick what they want and send you the order as a message. No apps, no sign-ups.

items.title: Your brand, your style
items.body: Your logo, colors, and business name. Your catalog looks like yours, not a generic template.

steps.title: Create your account
steps.body: Just your email and your business name. Two minutes, for real.

steps.title: Add your products
steps.body: Photos, prices, categories. All from your phone. Like posting on Instagram, but better.

steps.title: Share and sell
steps.body: Copy your link and put it wherever you already are: WhatsApp, Instagram, Google Maps.

cta.headline: 7 weeks free.
cta.note: Your catalog goes live in under 24 hours.

privacy.title: Privacy Notice
privacy.s1_body: catalog.mx, operated in the United Mexican States, is the data controller under the Mexican Federal Law on Protection of Personal Data Held by Private Parties (LFPDPPP). Controller contact: hola@catalog.mx.
privacy.s2_body: We collect: your business name, email address, phone number (optional), product information you add to your catalog (name, price, description, images), and technical usage data. We do not collect payment data or access your WhatsApp account.
privacy.s3_body: Your data is used to: (1) create and display your public digital catalog; (2) manage your account and authentication; (3) send you service-related notifications; (4) comply with legal obligations. We do not use your data for third-party advertising and we do not sell it.
privacy.s4_body: We use Firebase and Google Cloud Platform (GCP), services by Google LLC with servers in the United States. By using catalog.mx you accept that your data may be processed outside Mexico under Google's security guarantees (ISO 27001 and SOC 2 certifications).
privacy.s5_body: We use only essential cookies to keep your session active (Firebase Authentication). We do not use tracking or advertising cookies. See our Cookie Policy for full details.
privacy.s6_body: Under the LFPDPPP you have the right to Access, Rectification, Cancellation, and Opposition to the processing of your personal data. To exercise these rights write to hola@catalog.mx with your full name and specific request. We will respond within a maximum of 20 business days.
privacy.s7_body: For any questions about this privacy notice write to us at hola@catalog.mx.

terms.title: Terms and Conditions of Service
terms.s1_body: catalog.mx lets you create a digital catalog to share your products via WhatsApp. The service includes a 7-week free trial with no credit card required. After that period the service is billed monthly according to the current plan.
terms.s2_body: You are responsible for all information you publish in your catalog. You may not publish illegal, misleading, or third-party rights-infringing content, or content that violates consumer rights under Mexican law.
terms.s3_body: After creating your account, our team reviews and activates your catalog within 24 hours. We reserve the right to reject or suspend accounts that do not meet these policies without liability to the user.
terms.s4_body: After the free period, the service is billed monthly in advance. You can cancel at any time from your settings panel and the service will remain active until the end of the paid period. We do not issue refunds for partial periods.
terms.s5_body: catalog.mx is not responsible for transactions between you and your customers via WhatsApp. We are a digital catalog provider, not a payments or logistics provider. The commercial relationship with your customers is entirely yours.
terms.s6_body: We strive to keep the service available 24 hours a day. However, we do not guarantee uninterrupted availability and are not liable for damages from temporary interruptions due to maintenance, technical failures, or force majeure.
terms.s7_body: catalog.mx, its design, code, and brand are the property of their creators and protected by Mexican intellectual property laws. The content you publish in your catalog (photos, text, prices) is your property and you are solely responsible for having the rights to publish it.
terms.s8_body: These terms are governed by the laws of the United Mexican States. For any dispute arising from the use of the service, the parties submit to the jurisdiction of the competent courts of Mexico City, expressly waiving any other jurisdiction that may apply.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.s1_body: Cookies are small text files stored on your device when you visit our site. They allow the service to remember information between pages and sessions.
cookies.s2_body: We use only essential cookies required for the service to function: (1) Firebase Authentication session cookies to keep you securely signed in. (2) Technical Google Sign-In cookies required for the authentication flow with your Google account. We do not use advertising, behavioral tracking, or social media cookies.
cookies.s3_body: Without these cookies the service cannot identify you between pages, which would prevent you from accessing your admin panel and managing your catalog. There is no equivalent technical alternative.
cookies.s4_body: You can configure your browser to block or delete cookies. Note that disabling essential cookies will cause parts of the service to stop working. Check your browser guide: Chrome (Settings › Privacy), Firefox (Options › Privacy), Safari (Preferences › Privacy), Edge (Settings › Cookies).
cookies.s5_body: The authentication process uses Google LLC services (Firebase). By signing in with Google you also accept Google's Privacy Policies available at policies.google.com. We do not control or take responsibility for cookies set by Google.
cookies.s6_body: We may update this policy at any time. We will publish the updated version on this page with a new effective date. Continued use of the service after the update implies your acceptance.
cookies.s7_body: For any questions about our use of cookies write to us at hola@catalog.mx.
